set.body:
Type: acceptance gate
Work key: H03
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Recovery/backend lead
Scope: An old scientific backup cannot establish current permissions or resurrect withdrawn data.

Work kind: acceptance-gate
Suggested delivery tranche: T5; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Policy durability acknowledgments, authenticated ordering/checkpoints and catalog/blob backup manifests survive the declared isolated-component failure model; stale or incomplete evidence leaves access closed.
2. After backup, revoke a share, disable an account and withdraw shared data; remove source service/catalog/storage access and restore into a new target using separately controlled backup and current policy sources. Old sessions, permissions and withdrawn data remain unavailable.
3. Local retention/reference accounting, held/shared content and unsupported-erasure admission boundaries are enforced without unsafe garbage collection. Single-host simulation is labeled honestly; physical host/disk-loss and institution-specific media/retention still require O03.3/O04.2/Q03.1.

Expected review receipt: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/H03/receipt.json

Source/contracts:
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md
- docs/institutional-readiness-backlog.json

Blocked by:
- O03.1: bd-01M4W5P9194RGNP7DFGHB7ZK09

Review existing implementation receipts against this cross-cutting area. Do not duplicate or reparent their tasks. Close only with observed evidence; planning and previous unrelated tests are insufficient.

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
